revisions.2: max_retries in base.ini is 6, so reading it as retries or as attempts both give a wrong answer

brief: Answer three questions about this repository by reading it, and don't change any files. Take the settings as the repository ships them, with no environment variables set. 1. What page size does GET /orders use when the request gives no limit? 2. Which function sends the customer an email when an order is refunded? 3. When every attempt fails with a server error, how many times in all is a webhook delivery tried before it is given up? Write the answers to ANSWERS.json as {"page_size": <int>, "refund_email": "<file path>:<function name>", "webhook_attempts": <int>}.
